{"notes": "VISIT 3 (ending 5:30). Ratings still provisional. I still don't know who placed which dominoes, so no one gets credit or blame for the picture itself.

TABLE STATE: The right-side gap from visit 2 is closed. The upper line now curves round the tip and down to about (25,10), where it meets the lower curve. Every domino is dark, so everything is connected to the start and the whole fish should fall. I don't know who placed the final dominoes, and no hands were shown. Still worth a last check that the two lines meet cleanly at the notch.

OMAR: At 4:45 he said five more dominoes to go on the tip, curving down toward the other line, and that he'd shout when done. The table now matches. He's reliable and specific, and his visit 2 status now makes more sense. I didn't hear him shout done, so I'll ask next time. Execution looks good, but I only know the outcome.

HANA: She coordinated the tail clearly. She told Omar where to stop (close to the other line, no joining needed) and promised to check the whole tail and the fork when he's done. Good leadership and structure. I need to see whether she follows through on the check before time's up.

JACK: He stayed clear of the tail to avoid collisions and encouraged Omar. His note that the whole body is dark from the nose is accurate. Collaboration is strong and he's self-aware about space. He didn't mention the right-side gap, but it's now closed.

SOFIA: She agreed with Hana, told Omar to take his time, said she'd stay out of his corner, and offered to check the tail. That's supportive and collaborative, but I've still seen no hands-on work from her. I'll ask her privately what she did and how the team worked. No penalty yet.

TO DO: Ask who closed the gap and who checked the join. Ask Sofia privately for her contribution."}
